full_page.content:
1954, March 12
The following is a faithful transcription of a message to Helena Groth, written at the end of a copy of a letter dated October 4, 1915 by Mrs. Ella Traynor, by the Servant of God Fr. Solanus Casey O.F.M.Cap.
(to Helena Wilhite Groth)
Huntington, Ind. March 12th, 1954
"What is religion anyway?" asked a little 8 year-old. "What is Religion re Echoed in the ears of several. "Ah!" came an Earnest answer, "Religion is not only a science; Its the science of all science. It is the science of our happy dependence (we being each our own first neighbor) on God and our neighbor."
God bless you Helena - you and yours.
Fr. Solanus, O.F.M.Cap.
